description.describe_ch: 這科目從產品和生產的角度為學生提供時裝和紡織行業的生產概述，將介紹與印染和整理技術當前發展相關的主題。
description.describe_eh: This subject provides students an overview of fashion and textiles industry from the perspective of products and production. Topic related to current development of coloration and finishing technologies will be introduced.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。
因此，在作業、測驗或任何考核進行時作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人的行為，該次成績以“0”或“不及格”計，若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法提送。

(1) 學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
(2) 所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
(3) 上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。如果您正坐在一個可能在上課時和您聊天的人旁邊，請移到另一個座位，以免您屈服於誘惑。
(4) 當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
(5) 允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
(6) 要確保在上課時，將手機、PDA等移動設備收起並保持靜音。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Learning must be based on integrity. Any student who attempts to pass off work that he or she has not produced as his or her job is considered dishonest.
Therefore, students who cheat plagiarize, or assist others during assignments, tests, or any assessments will be graded as "0" or "failed".
If they are repeat offenders, they will be punished by Fengchia University's student rewards and punishments.

(1) Students should attend classes on time. Please do not choose the class if you cannot arrive on time during your class time. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you should arrive on time and be seated before class starts. If you have to leave or get out of class early for some reason, please let me know in advance.
(2) All students are expected to treat everyone in the classroom with respect and behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
(3) Please do not talk, read, sleep, or do other non-course-related assignments during class. Except for group discussions, marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
(4) Listen attentively when classmates give presentations or ask questions. When you give a presentation, you should speak loudly to your group or the class so your classmates can hear you.
(5) It is allowed to use laptops, tablets, and other devices to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
(6) Make sure to put away mobile phones, Pads, and other mobile devices and keep them silent during class.
